speaker: Lyra
text: You made it. I was beginning to think the stars had sent my letter to the wrong world.

speaker: Lyra
text: Welcome to the Asteria Observatory. Usually the sky is full of voices… but last night, every constellation went silent.

speaker: Lyra
text: There is still one light beneath the Verdant Sanctum. Will you come with me? I would rather not follow it alone.

choices.text: Of course. We will find it together.
First, tell me what we might find.

speaker: Lyra
text: Together. I like the sound of that. Professor Orion left us a map and an alarming number of warnings. Shall we ignore the alarming part?

speaker: Professor Orion
text: Ancient wards, restless crystal wisps, and a guardian that has forgotten its purpose. Lyra's astral focus can wake the shrine. Keep her safe, Wayfarer.

speaker: Lyra
text: Beyond those trees is our first answer. Stay close, watch the glowing crystals, and save your strongest magic for the guardian.

speaker: Lyra
text: Did you see it? A whole constellation inside a single shard! The guardian wasn't protecting treasure. It was protecting a memory.

speaker: Lyra
text: One light has returned to the sky. There are so many more to find… but for tonight, let's go home. Thank you for staying beside me.
